mappings.note: What the WWF works on is an organised effort to protect the environment. Not LO-47, because no category of organism is being defined.
Why wildlife is depleting relates a phenomenon to its causes. Not LO-58, because the item explains the loss rather than proposing a remedy.
What drives a species to extinction is cause identification. Grouped with the wildlife-depletion item rather than with the conservation-measure items.
Fauna as the animal life of an area is a term that sorts the living world. Not LO-46, because no two categories are contrasted.
Endemic species defined by their restricted range is a category of organism. Not LO-58, because no protective measure is involved.
What a zoo is differentiates one kind of protected place from the others by its function. Not LO-58, which is kept for named programmes, laws and reserves.
What a national park is distinguishes it from sanctuaries and reserves by its function. Grouped with the other protected-area definitions.
The biosphere as the life-supporting part of the earth is a defining term for the living world. Not LO-58, because no conservation action is named.
Picking the extinct species applies the threat categories that classify organisms. Not LO-49, because no cause of extinction is traced.
When Project Tiger was launched is a named conservation programme. Not LO-46, because no category is being distinguished.
The year of the National Forest Policy is an organised effort to protect forests. Grouped with the other laws and programmes.
The Forest Conservation Act is a legal conservation measure. Grouped with the other laws and programmes.
Desertification as fertile land turning to desert names the end state of a causal chain from deforestation. Not LO-47, because it describes a process of degradation rather than a class of organism.
Flora as the plant life of an area is a term that sorts the living world. Mirror of the fauna item.
Habitat as the surroundings an animal lives in is a defining term. Not LO-46, because nothing is contrasted.
Naming indiscriminate felling deforestation is environmental-hazard terminology. Not LO-49, which is used where the item traces deforestation's effects.
The natural causes of deforestation is cause identification. Not LO-58, because no remedy is proposed.
Species on the verge of extinction being called endangered is a threat category. Grouped with the other status terms.
Species confined to one area being endemic is a category of organism. Duplicate in substance of the endemic item above.
Defining a species as an interbreeding population is the basic unit of biological classification. Not LO-46, because nothing is contrasted.
What a wildlife sanctuary is distinguishes it from parks and reserves by its function. Grouped with the other protected-area definitions.
Finding which option is not a conservation category requires telling the protected-area types apart. Not LO-58, because no programme or law is named.
The Red Data Book as the record of threat categories is the scheme that classifies species. Not LO-58, because it records rather than protects.
Naming forest clearing deforestation is environmental-hazard terminology. Duplicate in substance of the earlier deforestation item.
What deforestation leads to is a phenomenon traced to its cause. Not LO-58, because consequences rather than remedies are asked for.
The gas plants need for photosynthesis is part of explaining that process. Not LO-49, because no environmental effect is traced.
Naming photosynthesis as the food-making process is a process explanation. Grouped with the carbon dioxide item.
Rising carbon dioxide causing warming relates a phenomenon to its cause. Not LO-50, because an effect rather than a mechanism is asked for.
Reduced rainfall causing drought or desertification is a causal chain. Grouped with the other deforestation consequences.
Loss of topsoil leading to erosion and barren land is a causal chain. Grouped with the other consequences.
The biosphere as the sphere supporting life is a defining term. Duplicate in substance of the earlier biosphere item.
Biodiversity as the variety of living organisms is a defining term for the living world. Not LO-58, because no protection is involved.
Naming the biosphere reserve with Himalayan and Western Ghats affinities identifies a specific protected area. Not LO-46, because no category is distinguished.
What is prohibited in parks, sanctuaries and reserves is a protective rule. Not LO-46, because the categories are given rather than contrasted.
Matching the description of undisturbed animal protection to a sanctuary distinguishes protected-area types by function. Grouped with the other definitional items.
Matching free use of habitat and resources to a national park distinguishes protected-area types. Grouped with the sanctuary item.
Matching large protected land including tribal life to a biosphere reserve distinguishes the three categories. Grouped with the other two.
Naming the national park inside the Pachmarhi reserve identifies a specific protected area. Not LO-46, since no category boundary is tested.
Naming the two sanctuaries inside the Pachmarhi reserve identifies specific protected areas. Grouped with the preceding item.
Flora as the plants of a particular area is a defining term. Duplicate in substance of the earlier flora item.
